title: LG C2/C3: eARC not working with soundbars/AVRs (fast fixes)
audience: LG C2/C3 owners with sound dropouts or Atmos missing.

quick.fast: eARC On, Pass Through, Bitstream; CEC On; reboot chain TV->AVR->Source.
quick.deeper: Denon/Marantz HDMI Control & ARC/eARC On; assign TV Audio input; cable sanity.

steps: Settings -> Sound -> eARC = On; Digital Sound Out = Pass Through; HDMI Input Audio = Bitstream; SIMPLINK = On.
Disable TV speakers when using eARC.
Power off all; power on TV -> AVR/Soundbar -> Source.
Denon: Setup -> Video -> HDMI Setup -> HDMI Control On; ARC/eARC On; set TV Audio input.
why: eARC/CEC handshakes plus PCM vs bitstream cause dropouts; this stabilizes negotiation.
